@graph.name: Board of Supervisors
@graph.description: Marin County's elected governing body; adopts the plan and approves major funding and policy decisions.

@graph.name: County Executive Office
@graph.description: Sponsors the plan, coordinates cross-department implementation, and owns Countywide reporting.

@graph.name: Community Development Agency
@graph.description: Leads housing production, planning, and Housing Trust Fund initiatives.

@graph.name: Department of Health and Human Services
@graph.description: Leads housing stability programs and coordinates on climate and sustainability initiatives.

@graph.name: Marin Housing Authority
@graph.description: Partner agency administering rental assistance and affordable housing programs alongside County initiatives.

@graph.name: Marin County residents
@graph.description: People who live in Marin County; participate through surveys, workshops, and public comment on the draft and ongoing plan.
